controller.quote: GOV.UK (or www.gov.uk) is provided by the Government Digital Service ( GDS ), part of the Department for Science, Innovation & Technology ( DSIT ). DSIT and other government departments, agencies and organisations are joint controllers for pages that start ‘www.gov.uk’.

contact.quote: Privacy Team gds.data.protection@dsit.gov.uk You can also contact our Data Protection Officer ( DPO ): DSIT Data Protection Officer Department for Science, Innovation and Technology 22-26 Whitehall London SW1A 2EG dataprotection@dsit.gov.uk

dpo.quote: You can also contact our Data Protection Officer ( DPO ): DSIT Data Protection Officer Department for Science, Innovation and Technology 22-26 Whitehall London SW1A 2EG dataprotection@dsit.gov.uk

purposes.quote: We collect your personal data in order to: gather feedback to improve our services

legal_basis.quote: The legal basis for processing data collected with Google Analytics and SpeedCurve RUM on GOV.UK and other government digital services is your consent.

recipients.quote: The data we collect may be shared with other government departments, agencies and organisations. It may also be shared with our technology suppliers, for example our hosting provider.

transfers.quote: Data collected by Google Analytics and SpeedCurve RUM may be transferred outside the EEA for processing. Where data processing happens in the US

retention.quote: We will: keep your email data until you unsubscribe keep your feedback data for 2 years delete access log data which contain your IP address after 120 days

rights.quote: You have the right to request: information about how your personal data is processed a copy of that personal data that anything inaccurate in your personal data is corrected immediately

complaint.quote: You can also make a complaint to the Information Commissioner, who is an independent regulator.

notes: No statement on automated decision-making or profiling in the notice (Google Ad personalisation mention is not an ADM statement).
